Medieval spring festival

Spring is coming and Calendimaggio celebrates it! Calendimaggio is one of the most beautiful occasions to experience a medieval atmosphere.

Learn Italian in a town that goes back to the Middle Ages. Enjoy the festival while the residents prepare it, and take part in the events that start one week before Calendimaggio.
